title: Justice was Done
question: What is the distinction between them?

meanings.usage: 可指法律上的公正审判，也可指抽象的正义概念
指复杂的组织或机构系统
形容需要付出大量努力的困难工作或旅程
与具体事物相对的，存在于概念中的

meanings.meaning: 沉闷的；压低的；听不清的
meanings.usage: 形容声音被压抑或减弱的
指吸引人做某事的力量或冲动
指确定某物的确切位置
指从某处出来或显露出来
指把某人或某物交给另一个人或权威机构
指在没有外部压力的情况下自己去做某事
指开始进行一项工作或任务
指用工具凿开或削去材料
指从一种用途或形式改变为另一种
指建筑物及其所在的场地，常用复数形式

phrases.usage: 表示正义已经得到伸张或实现

examples.en: Justice has been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

phrases.usage: 表示某人自食其果、活该倒霉

examples.en: The shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
examples.zh: 店员们一定会觉得忍不住想说'他活该'。

examples.en: The manager promptly rang up the fire brigade.
examples.zh: 经理立刻给消防队打了电话。

examples.en: He had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
examples.zh: 他试图在夜间闯入商店，但卡在了烟囱里。

examples.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

examples.en: We are, in part, admitting that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord.
examples.zh: 我们在某种程度上承认，某些环境因素使得正义能够自行发挥作用。

phrases.usage: 毫无疑问地；确定无疑地

examples.en: We might say that justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.
examples.zh: 当一个人的清白或罪行被毫无疑问地证实后，我们可以说正义得到了伸张。

examples.en: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure that they will find it.
examples.zh: 那些寻求正义的人，踏上了艰难的旅程，而且永远无法确定他们能否找到它。

examples.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning.
examples.zh: 一天早上，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的场所内被抓时。

phrases.usage: 通过做某事使某人获救

examples.en: The fire fighters were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 消防队员最终通过在墙上凿开一个大洞将他救了出来。

sentences.en: The word justice is usually associated with courts of law.
sentences.zh: “正义”一词通常与法庭联系在一起。

sentences.en: We might say that justice has been done when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.
sentences.zh: 当一个人的清白或罪行被无可置疑地证明时，我们可能会说正义得到了伸张。

sentences.en: Justice is part of the complex machinery of the law.
sentences.zh: 正义是法律复杂机制的一部分。

sentences.en: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey and can never be sure that they will find it.
sentences.zh: 追求正义的人会踏上一段艰难的旅程，而且永远无法确定他们是否会找到它。

sentences.en: Judges, however wise or eminent, are human and can make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 法官，无论多么明智或杰出，都是人，也可能犯错误。

sentences.en: There are rare instances when justice almost ceases to be an abstract concept.
sentences.zh: 在极少数情况下，正义几乎不再是一个抽象的概念。

sentences.en: Reward or punishment are meted out quite independent of human interference.
sentences.zh: 奖励或惩罚在完全没有人类干预的情况下被施加。

sentences.en: At such times, justice acts like a living force.
sentences.zh: 在这种时候，正义就像一股活生生的力量。

sentences.en: When we use a phrase like 'it serves him right',
sentences.zh: 当我们使用“活该”这样的短语时，

sentences.en: we are, in part, admitting that a certain set of circumstances has enabled justice to act of its own accord.
sentences.zh: 我们部分承认了某种情况使正义得以自然而然地发挥作用。

sentences.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning,
sentences.zh: 一天早上，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的院子里被抓到时，

sentences.en: the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
sentences.zh: 店员们一定觉得很难抵制住说“活该”的冲动。

sentences.en: The shop was an old converted house with many large, disused fireplaces and tall, narrow chimneys.
sentences.zh: 这家店是一座由老房子改建而成的，有很多大的废弃壁炉和又高又窄的烟囱。

sentences.en: Towards midday, a girl heard a muffled cry coming from behind one of the walls.
sentences.zh: 快到中午时，一个女孩听到墙后传来一阵低沉的哭声。

sentences.en: As the cry was repeated several times,
sentences.zh: 哭声重复了几次之后，

sentences.en: she ran to tell the manager who promptly rang up the fire brigade.
sentences.zh: 她跑去告诉经理，经理立刻给消防队打了电话。

sentences.en: The cry had certainly come from one of the chimneys,
sentences.zh: 哭声确实是从一个烟囱里传出来的，

sentences.en: but as there were so many of them, the firemen could not be certain which one it was.
sentences.zh: 但由于烟囱太多，消防员无法确定是哪一个。

sentences.en: They located the right chimney by tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries.
sentences.zh: 他们通过敲击墙壁并聆听那个人的哭声来确定正确的烟囱。

sentences.en: After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick,
sentences.zh: 在凿穿一堵18英寸厚的墙后，

sentences.en: they found that a man had been trapped in the chimney.
sentences.zh: 他们发现一个人被困在烟囱里了。

sentences.en: As it was extremely narrow, the man was unable to move,
sentences.zh: 由于烟囱非常狭窄，那个人无法动弹，

sentences.en: but the fire fighters were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
sentences.zh: 但消防员最终通过在墙上凿开一个大洞，成功地解救了他。

sentences.en: The sorry-looking, blackened figure that emerged,
sentences.zh: 那个狼狈不堪、浑身漆黑的人影出现后，

sentences.en: admitted at once that he had tried to break into the shop during the night but had got stuck in the chimney.
sentences.zh: 立刻承认他曾试图在夜间闯入商店，但被卡在了烟囱里。

sentences.en: He had been there for nearly ten hours.
sentences.zh: 他已经在里面待了将近十个小时。

sentences.en: Justice had been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
sentences.zh: 甚至在将那个人移交给警方之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

exercises.prompt: “表示过去发生的动作或状态持续到现在，或对现在有影响。常与already, just, yet, for, since等词连用。” 描述的是哪个语法点？
options: make it + 形容词 + for sb. to do sth.
关系从句（限制性定语从句）
exercises.explain: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)：have/has + 过去分词：用于表示过去的动作与现在有关联，或动作已发生但强调其结果。

在此过程中，他玩得很开心，并且不停地告诉所有人他有多么讨厌医院。
在那些日子里，拳击手们赤手空拳地搏斗以争夺奖金。

grammar.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
grammar.definition: 当句子的主语是动作的承受者时使用被动语态。主动语态中动作的执行者（agent）可以用by引出，但经常被省略。
grammar.structure: be + 过去分词 (be + past participle)
grammar.usage: 用于强调动作的承受者，或动作执行者不明确、不重要时。

examples.en: Justice is done.
examples.zh: 正义得到伸张。

examples.en: Justice has been done even before the man was handed over to the police.
examples.zh: 甚至在这个人移交给警察之前，正义就已经得到了伸张。

examples.en: The shop was an old converted house.
examples.zh: 那家商店是一栋改建的老房子。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或状态持续到现在，或对现在有影响。常与already, just, yet, for, since等词连用。
grammar.usage: 用于表示过去的动作与现在有关联，或动作已发生但强调其结果。

examples.en: The cry was repeated several times.
examples.zh: 哭喊声重复了好几次。

examples.en: He had been there for nearly ten hours.
examples.zh: 他在那里已经呆了将近十个小时。

examples.en: She ran to tell the manager who promptly rang up the fire brigade.
examples.zh: 她跑去告诉经理，经理立刻给消防队打了电话。

grammar.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.definition: 用于修饰名词或代词的从句，由关系代词（who, whom, which, that）或关系副词（where, when, why）引导。
grammar.structure: 名词/代词 + 关系词 + 从句
grammar.usage: 用于提供关于某人或某物的额外信息。

examples.en: The cry had certainly come from one of the chimneys, but as there were so many of them, the firemen could not be certain which one it was.
examples.zh: 哭喊声确实是从某个烟囱里传来的，但由于烟囱太多，消防员无法确定是哪一个。

examples.en: Those who seek it, undertake an arduous journey.
examples.zh: 那些寻求正义的人，踏上了艰难的旅程。

examples.en: Justice has been done.
examples.zh: 正义已经得到伸张。

examples.en: Justice will be done eventually.
examples.zh: 正义最终会得到伸张。

examples.en: It serves you right for being late.
examples.zh: 你迟到，活该。

examples.en: It serves her right for not studying.
examples.zh: 她不学习，活该。

patterns.pattern: Someone + be + unable to + 动词原形

original.en: As it was extremely narrow, the man was unable to move.
original.zh: 由于烟囱非常狭窄，这个人无法动弹。

examples.en: She was unable to attend the meeting.
examples.zh: 她无法参加会议。

examples.en: I was unable to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 我无法解决这个问题。

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主句

original.en: When a thief was caught on the premises of a large jewellery store one morning, the shop assistants must have found it impossible to resist the temptation to say 'it serves him right'.
original.zh: 一天早上，当一个小偷在一家大型珠宝店的场所内被抓时，店员们一定会觉得忍不住想说'他活该'。

examples.en: When I was young, I used to play in the park.
examples.zh: 当我年轻的时候，我常在公园里玩。

examples.en: When he arrived home, it was already dark.
examples.zh: 当他到家时，天已经黑了。
